title: Sales Tax — repeating a Zip Code search sends a hidden State and returns nothing
requirementSource: NM-4021 §6.2 — with a Zip Code entered, State/County/City are cleared and disabled and do not take part in the search
stepsToReproduce: Navigate to Tax → Sales Tax for office 1101 (/navigator/locations/1101/taxes/sales-tax) on e2e as the automation user.
Type Zip Code 90210 and click Search — 1 record.
Click Search again without changing anything.
expectedBehavior: The same record is returned; the request carries only zipCode and effectiveDate.
actualBehavior: After the first search the disabled State field silently reverts to AK. Every later search sends stateId=59 (AK) with zipCode=90210 and returns 0 records. Reproduced 3/3 times; it also hits a changed Effective Date (e.g. 04/01/2025), so it looks like a wrong as-of result.

verificationLog.finding: Reproduced live on e2e (office 1101) during NM-4021 automation; the affected test asserts the documented behaviour under test.fail.
Also reproduced on the Sales Tax History tab (TC-TAX-ST-059).
